test_title: PYST 72: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Eight people (P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W) are sitting around a circular table, facing towards the centre.

There are exactly three people sitting between U and V. P is an immediate neighbour of both T and Q. Q sits to the immediate right of U. W is an immediate neighbour of both R and S. R sits second to the right of T.

How many people sit between W and Q, when counted from the right of W?
solution:
Given: Q, U, V, P, T, R, W and S are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Q sits to the immediate right of U.

There are exactly three people between U and V.

P is an immediate neighbour of both T and Q.

R sits second to the right of T.

W is an immediate neighbour of both R and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/711c5efd7c50fb1047e2a938d8e15a3a65bd1a385d91bfc2c0b765070d03b955.png] 

So, there are 2 people between W and Q from the right of W.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
